materials.name: 6061-T6 aluminum
selectionRules: Use when weight matters and loads are moderate.
Add threaded inserts or larger thread engagement for repeated assembly.

materials.name: 45 steel / AISI 1045
manufacturingNotes: can be normalized or quenched and tempered
selectionRules: Use for shafts and torque-carrying parts.

materials.name: 304 stainless steel
manufacturingNotes: avoid assuming high yield strength without grade condition
selectionRules: Use where corrosion resistance is more important than low cost.
Check galling risk for stainless threaded assemblies.

materials.name: Q235B structural steel
selectionRules: Use for welded machine frames and low-speed equipment.
Add weld symbols, anti-rust coating, and tolerance notes.
